name: Contract parties before role definitions and a compensation annexure
pages:
EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT
This agreement is made on 03 July 2026 between Northbridge Labs Private Limited (hereinafter referred to as the Employer) and Leela Rao (hereinafter referred to as the Employee).
The Employee is appointed as Senior Platform Engineer. Employment will commence on 14 August 2026. This fixed-term contract ends on 13 August 2028.
The employee must give 30 days notice before resignation. If the contract is terminated, access must be returned. This clause does not record an actual termination.

ANNEXURE A - COMPENSATION
Employee Name: LEELA RAO
Employer: NORTHBRIDGE LABS PRIVATE LIMITED
Annual CTC: INR 24 lakh per annum
Monthly Gross: INR 180000
One-time Joining Bonus: INR 50000
Reimbursement Limit: INR 15000
The annual CTC includes variable compensation; reimbursements and the one-time joining bonus must not be added to the stated annual CTC.

name: Narrative dates distinguish signing from joining and preserve legal names
text:
EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT
Signed on 02 September 2026.
Willow Systems (India) Limited is the employer under this contract. The employee is Arjun Menon.
You are appointed as Data Engineer. Your date of joining is September 21, 2026. The contract expires on 20th September 2027.
Your annual remuneration is INR 1,800,000 per annum. Travel reimbursement is capped at INR 20000.
The client contact is Mira Shah; she is not the employee. Your manager is Dev Kapoor.
Confidentiality obligations continue after employment.
